name: Mega-Feats Revisited
body:
Mega-Feats Revisited is intended as the largest collection of new feats available for the Pathfinder Roleplaying Game, more than doubling character options presented in either the first edition of Mega-Feats, or in the Pathfinder RPG core rules themselves! Many of the best feats from other Skortched Urf Studios and Otherverse Games products have migrated into this massive sourcebook.

Feats

Battle Step (Combat)

Heal Back Stronger (General)

Thuggish Brawler (Combat)

Open Game Content under the site's blanket OGL 1.0a declaration (d20pfsrd.com/extras/legal/). Author/publisher: Otherverse Games.
